integrity: The infinite claim is proved analytically. Finite computation is used only for the explicitly bounded small-order closure and for corroborative stress tests. Previously known complete-graph and two-color cases are identified as prior coverage.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs.
The two-color criterion is prior work via neighborhood-balanced coloring; originality is claimed only for the completed strong-majority classification beyond that branch.
Orders at most eleven are closed by exhaustive count-matrix enumeration; all larger orders are covered by a separate analytic construction.
title: Strong majority number of complete multipartite graphs
